melder.aether.spellbook.existence.manage.label: managed_spell_mode
melder.aether.spellbook.existence.manage.role: Module holding the ManagedSpellMode enum a managed binding chooses its pool policy from.
responsibilities: exports ManagedSpellMode to Bind, Spell, the pool, SpellBinder, scan_bind and the package root

melder.aether.spellbook.existence.manage.label: ManagedSpellMode
melder.aether.spellbook.existence.manage.role: Pool policy of a managed spell, chosen at bind with managed_spell_mode: what a lease does when no idle object is waiting.
responsibilities: elastic: a miss always builds; managed_spell_limit is the most idle objects kept (default 256), trimmed like the kernel pools' idle objects; never refuses
limited_quantity: managed_spell_limit (required) is the most objects alive at once, idle plus out; a miss at the limit refuses before building anything
queue: like limited_quantity, but a miss at the limit waits up to managed_spell_timeout_seconds (required) for a release, which serves the waiter, and refuses at the deadline
identity data: with the limit, the timeout and the reset names it is hashed into a managed spell's id, recorded by name in its crystal and replayed by restore and graft; __str__ returns the bare name
